title: Prosōdia et Metrum Epicum
subtitle: Hexameter dactylicus: sex pedēs, longitūdō syllabārum (nātūrālis et “positiōne”), caesūra — īnstrūmenta fundāmentālia ad legendum versum epicum vōce clārā.
objectives: Recitāre structūram hexametrī dactylicī: sex pedēs, patrōnus dactylus/spondēus, rēgula “quīntī pedis”
Applicāre rēgulās longitūdinis syllabārum: nātūrālis (vōcālis longa/diphthongus) vel “positiōne” (vōcālis brevis + duae cōnsonantēs sequentēs)
Reconhōscere caesūram (“sectiōnem”) ut pausam rhythmicam intrā versum, praesertim in pede tertiō
Applicāre haec prīncipia ad versum I.1 Iliadis (Gradū VII priōre) ut exemplum īnfōrmāns, sine reclāmāre praecīsiōnem absolūtam sine adiūtōriō magistrī vīvī

content.intro: Poēsis epica Graeca (Homērus, et posteā imitātōrēs ut Apollōnius Rhodius) est composita in hexametrō dactylicō — metrum "quantitātīvum" (basātum in longitūdine syllabārum, nōn accentū tōnicō ut in poēsī Anglicā/Lūsitānicā modernā), sex pedum, quod discipulus antīquus discēbat scandere ("legere metricē") vōce clārā ante quidquam aliud.
content.explanation: Fundāmentum: quaelibet syllaba est longa (—) vel brevis (⏑), sīcut vōcālēs individuae (Gradū I) sunt longae vel brevēs — sed cum rēgulā additā: syllaba brevis NĀTŪRĀLITER fit LONGA "positiōne" sī sequuntur duae (vel plūrēs) cōnsonantēs (etiam trāns līneam verbōrum!). Pēs est combīnātiō syllabārum fōrmāns ūnitātem rhythmicam repetītam.

rules.heading: a) Structūra Hexametrī
rules.body:
PēsPatrōnus Permissus
1–4dactylus (— ⏑⏑) VEL spondēus (— —), līberē
5dactylus (— ⏑⏑), FERĒ SEMPER (spondēus rārus, "versus spondiacus")
6duae syllabae (— — vel — ⏑, ultima syllaba "anceps")

"Hexameter" ("sex mēnsūrae") nōminat sex pedēs; "dactylicus" nōminat pedem fundāmentālem (dactylus, ā Graecō "digitus", comparāns longitūdinem inaequālem articulōrum digitī: ūnum longum, duo brevia).

rules.heading: b) Longitūdō “Positiōne”
rules.body: Syllaba brevis (vōcālis brevis, sine cōnsonantibus sequentibus complicantibus, ex Gradibus I/III) fit LONGA sī duae (vel plūrēs) cōnsonantēs sequuntur — etiam sī illae cōnsonantēs incipiunt verbum sequēns! Hoc explicat cūr syllaba vīsa "brevis" (ex vōcālī sōlā) potest occupāre elementum longum (—) in pede: rhythmus audītur, nōn sōlum vōcālis ipsa.

rules.heading: c) Caesūra
rules.body: Caesūra ("sectiō") est pausa verbōrum (fīnis ūnīus verbī, initium alterīus) INTRĀ pedem (nōn inter pedēs) — creāns pausam rhythmicam mediam versūs, analoga "respīrātiōnī" in lēctiōne vōce clārā. Caesūra PRINCIPĀLIS typicē occurrit in pede tertiō: post prīmam syllabam longam dactylī (caesūra "masculīna"/"penthēmimerēs") vel inter duās syllabās brevēs (caesūra "fēminīna"/"trochaica"). Legere versum Homēricum bene requīrit pausam ibi, nōn sōlum ad fīnem versūs.

examples: μῆνιν ἄειδε θεὰ... — Prīmī pedēs versūs I.1 Iliadis: patrōnus generālis dactylicus praedomināns, sīcut typicum initiīs versuum epicōrum.
— ⏑⏑ (dactylus) vs. — — (spondēus): duo patrōnī permissī prō pedibus 1–4.
Πηληϊάδεω: syllabae multiplicēs, aliquae subiectae synizēsī (contractiōne metricā duārum vōcālium in ūnam syllabam prō necessitāte rhythmicā) — phaenomenon Homericum frequēns, nōn error.
Caesūra post tertium pedem: pausa “respīrātiōnis” quam recitātor antīquus (ῥαψῳδός) observābat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Suppōnere longitūdinem syllabae dēpendēre sōlum ā longitūdine vōcālis ipsīus (ex Gradū I), ignōrandō rēgulam “positiōne”.
commonMistakes.right: Applicāre AMBĀS rēgulās: longitūdo nātūrālis (vōcālis/diphthongus) ET longitūdo positiōne (cōnsonantēs sequentēs) — syllaba potest esse longa per utramque ratiōnem.
commonMistakes.why: Sine rēgulā positiōne, multī versūs Homericī vidērentur “nōn scandere” correctē — rēgula est essentiālis, nōn optiōnālis.

commonMistakes.wrong: Reclāmāre praecīsiōnem absolūtam scandendī quemlibet versum sine practica extēnsā vel adiūtōriō magistrī.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere hanc lēctiōnem ut INTRODUCTIŌNEM ad prīncipia (structūra hexametrī, longitūdo, caesūra) — māgistrium plēnum scandendī requīrit practicam repetītam cum textibus multīs.
commonMistakes.why: Honestās pedagogica: metrum est arte discenda per practicam, nōn sōlum theoria ūnīus lēctiōnis absorbenda.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ignōrāre synizēsim (contractiōnem metricam) ut anōmaliam inexplicābilem, frūstrandō sē cūr numerus syllabārum nōn concordat expectātiōne.
commonMistakes.right: Recognōscere synizēsim (et alia phaenomena metrica sīcut digamma, Gradū VII priōre) ut convention normālem poēsis epicae, adiuvantem versum “fittere” schēmatī rhythmicō requīsītō.
commonMistakes.why: Poēta epicus antīquus habuit repertōrium licentiārum metricārum (synizēsis, digamma, augmentum omissum, fōrmae dialectī variābilēs) ad servandum rhythmum sine sacrificāre sēnsum.

items.prompt: Quī pēs est FERĒ SEMPER dactylus (rārō spondēus)?

items.explanation: Rēgula positiōne, distīncta ā longitūdine nātūrālī vōcālis.

options: pausa verbōrum intrā pedem, creāns pausam rhythmicam
items.explanation: Caesūra est fenomenon normāle et essentiāle prōsodiae epicae.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Pedēs 1–4 hexametrī possunt esse aut dactylī aut spondēī, līberē.
Sextus pēs hexametrī cōnsistit semper ex tribus syllabīs (dactylus purus).
items.explanation: Falsum: sextus pēs habet duās syllabās (spondēus vel trochaeus, ultima anceps).

items.statement: Synizēsis est contractiō metrica duārum vōcālium in ūnam syllabam, convention normālis in poēsī epicā.
Māgistrium plēnum scandendī quemlibet versum Homericum requīrit sōlum ūnam lēctiōnem theoricam, sine practicā ūllā.

summary: Hexameter dactylicus: sex pedēs; pedēs 1-4 dactylus (— ⏑⏑) vel spondēus (— —) līberē; pēs 5 ferē semper dactylus; pēs 6 duae syllabae (ultima anceps).
Syllaba est longa nātūrāliter (vōcālis longa/diphthongus, Gradū I) VEL “positiōne” (vōcālis brevis + duae cōnsonantēs sequentēs, etiam trāns verba).
Caesūra: pausa verbōrum intrā pedem (typicē pēs III), creāns pausam rhythmicam “respīrātōriam” mediam versūs.
Phaenomena metrica speciālia (synizēsis, digamma effectīvum, augmentum omissum, Gradū VII priōre) sunt licentiae normālēs poēsis epicae.
